_doc: Reference briefs — Step 0 of the art pipeline (see docs/art/REFERENCE_RESEARCH_STEP.md). Built from web reference research, NOT off the top of the head. gen_from_brief.py builds every prompt from these; never hand-write a prompt that bypasses this file. Keys match the game's unit art keys (assets/sprites/units/...). A '<key>__dead' target composes the base unit's subject+family with corpse_by_family.
style: pixel art, high contrast, bold clean readable silhouette, full color, single character
framing_live: full body, centered, standing, plain solid flat gray background, no ground, no shadow
framing_dead: top-down three-quarter view looking down at the body lying flat on the ground, centered, plain solid flat gray background
base_negatives: blurry, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, multiple characters, cropped, border, purple tint, monochrome, extra limbs, deformed
live_negatives: cast shadow, drop shadow, ground shadow, shadow under feet, floor, ground, base, platform, standing surface, reflection, background scenery, wall, room

key_features: clearly DEAD mutant, lifeless and limp
sprawled on its back with limbs splayed out to the sides
flattened silhouette lying flat on the ground, NOT standing
a pool of glowing green ichor spreading under the body
slack open jaw, dim / dead eyes (no glow)
desaturated and darker than a living one
mutant.negatives: standing, upright, walking, alive, action pose, glowing eyes, tipped-over standing figure, compact ball shape, floating

key_features: clearly DESTROYED robot, wrecked and inert
broken apart on the ground, one rotor snapped off
dark dead optic (no glow), sparks and scorch marks
a small pool of black oil and scattered debris under it
robot.negatives: hovering, flying, upright, alive, glowing eye, intact, floating, action pose

key_features: clearly DEAD human, lifeless and limp
sprawled on the ground with arms and legs splayed
flattened silhouette lying flat, NOT standing
a dark red blood pool spreading under the body
weapon fallen on the ground beside the body
desaturated and darker than a living one
human.negatives: standing, upright, walking, alive, action pose, aiming, tipped-over standing figure, floating
